```python
from collections import deque

def zigzag(root):
    out = []
    if not root:
        return out
    q = deque([root])
    left_to_right = True
    while q:
        level = []
        for _ in range(len(q)):
            node = q.popleft()
            level.append(node.val)
            if node.left:
                q.append(node.left)
            if node.right:
                q.append(node.right)
        if not left_to_right:
            level.reverse()
        out.append(level)
        left_to_right = not left_to_right
    return out
```
